name: Cell-based AMR volume rendering via front/back-face subtraction
aliases: Cube intersection length via signed texcoord.z
definition: A volume rendering technique for Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) datasets that represents cells as cubes and computes the integral along the line-of-sight by subtracting the z-coordinate of back-facing fragments from front-facing fragments, avoiding the need for a perspective-correct kernel texture.
summary: This method renders AMR datasets by treating cells as cubes and using front/back-face subtraction to compute perspective-correct line-of-sight integrals without mipmapped textures.
